physical_version: portugal-v2.3 with explicit native input adaptations
catalogue_description: Core-4, Core-15, Core-30 Normal plus four focused variants, Premium Normal and Premium All-in.

thesis_properties.scalability: Core-30 Normal versus Premium Normal; Core-30 Topologia for reconfiguration. Report quality, latency, memory and adaptation cost. Pure size effects need composition-controlled comparisons.
thesis_properties.deployability: Use Core-30 Combinado and Premium All-in as operating workloads, with measured packaging, reconstruction, target compatibility, updates and recovery.
thesis_properties.safety: Core-30 Safety changes three declared electrical contracts; finite physical and service limits remain active in every scenario.
thesis_properties.robustness: Core-30 Robustness includes health, grid interruptions and separate measurement-noise inputs; Premium All-in also includes measurement noise. The existing simulator applies independent channel noise; derived decision aids remain exact.

pricing: One common full grid purchase tariff: shared/pricing_btn_bi.parquet, EUR/kWh. Grid export 0. Market disabled in dataset schemas; enable original settlement and configure 0.8 in experiment schemas. No local discount in price series. Explicit DR only in Premium All-in.
holdout: Development/confirmation are reserved dates and event inputs within the same named scenarios, not additional dataset variants.
scope: Current named catalogue only. Prior factorial catalogues and Core DR evidence are archived.
validation_scope: Dataset construction only. Static integrity checks; no usage/controller evaluation for this common-tariff revision. Previous individual-tariff simulations are historical.
